mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.event_id, e.event_code, e.source_type AS event_source, l.prediction_batch_id, b.batch_code, b.base_time, b.horizon_minutes, b.status AS batch_status, b.pipeline_version, b.feature_mapping_version, b.input_hash, b.output_hash, l.prediction_run_id, l.prediction_gate_id, l.model_id, COALESCE(r.model_code, m.model_code) AS model_code, COALESCE(r.model_version, m.model_version) AS model_version, COALESCE(r.target_type, m.target_type) AS target_type, r.input_window_start, r.input_window_end, COALESCE(r.artifact_hash, m.artifact_hash) AS artifact_hash, r.input_schema_hash, r.result_hash AS run_result_hash, l.first_exceedance_time, l.lead_time_minutes, l.peak_predicted_value, l.consecutive_exceedance_steps, l.forecast_snapshot_json, l.result_hash, g.execution_mode AS gate_execution_mode, g.execution_eligible AS gate_execution_eligible, g.gate_hash, g.issues_json AS gate_issues_json, g.evaluated_at AS gate_evaluated_at, l.created_at FROM em_event_prediction_link l JOIN em_monitoring_event e ON e.id = l.event_id JOIN em_prediction_batch b ON b.id = l.prediction_batch_id LEFT JOIN em_prediction_run r ON r.id = l.prediction_run_id LEFT JOIN em_prediction_model m ON m.id = l.model_id LEFT JOIN em_prediction_execution_gate g ON g.id = l.prediction_gate_id WHERE l.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO em_event_prediction_link (event_id, prediction_batch_id, prediction_run_id, prediction_gate_id, model_id, first_exceedance_time, lead_time_minutes, peak_predicted_value, consecutive_exceedance_steps, forecast_snapshot_json, result_hash) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{predictionBatchId}, #{predictionRunId}, #{predictionGateId}, #{modelId}, #{firstExceedanceTime}, #{leadTimeMinutes}, #{peakPredictedValue}, #{consecutiveExceedanceSteps}, #{forecastSnapshotJson}, #{resultHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE first_exceedance_time = VALUES(first_exceedance_time), prediction_gate_id = VALUES(prediction_gate_id), lead_time_minutes = VALUES(lead_time_minutes), peak_predicted_value = VALUES(peak_predicted_value), consecutive_exceedance_steps = VALUES(consecutive_exceedance_steps), forecast_snapshot_json = VALUES(forecast_snapshot_json), result_hash = VALUES(result_hash)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_event_prediction_link WHERE prediction_batch_id = #{batchId}
